root_idea.summary: Pairing or joining one thing with another as its counterpart, associate, or complement.
root_idea.development: The pairing principle extends to spouses, paired or contrasting entities, associated groups, and kinds understood as related classes. It can also describe a covering or furnishing associated with what it is placed upon.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form.

senses.definition: To pair, couple, or unite one thing or person with another as its counterpart.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic pairing constructions, the counterparts may be male and female, spouses or mate-like partners, or souls joined with corresponding bodies, records, works, groups, or followers. This use is distinct from ordinary human marriage.

senses.definition: To give one person in marriage to another; to marry one person to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the conventional marriage construction, as in marrying a woman to a man. This is distinguished from pairing people with houris or other counterparts in the non-marital sense.

senses.definition: A pair or coupled counterpart; one of two things joined as a pair, and sometimes the pair or couple collectively.
senses.usage_conditions: The paired things may be alike or contrasting. The noun can refer to a fellow or like, or to the two paired things together; number and context determine which reading is intended.

senses.definition: A spouse: a husband or wife regarded as the partner of the other.
senses.usage_conditions: The same noun can refer to either sex; the surrounding context determines whether husband or wife is intended.

senses.definition: An associate, consociate, comrade, or peer joined to others by companionship, allegiance, or shared conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic plural constructions, the term can denote associates or like-minded counterparts rather than marital spouses.

senses.definition: A kind, sort, species, or category.
senses.usage_conditions: This use denotes a class or variety understood as related to other classes or varieties, including kinds of created things and kinds of punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Making things to be of different kinds or species.
To become or form a pair with another, or to make a coupling or pairing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe pairing with a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To marry one another or intermarry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a reciprocal marital use of the Form III verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make two phrases or sentences mutually corresponding in sound, rhyme, measure, connection, or dependence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical or stylistic construction concerning the relation between expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To marry, take a spouse, or enter a marital alliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is also used for marrying into a family or group; the sources report variation in some prepositional constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For sleep to pervade or overcome someone.
To marry one another or intermarry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a people or group engaging in reciprocal marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pair or couple with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage describes birds pairing with one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutual correspondence or resemblance between adjacent words, phrases, or sentences, especially in sound, rhyme, measure, connection, or dependence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical term for parallel or balanced expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vitriol, a medicinal salt and an ingredient in ink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an Arabicized technical term for a kind of salt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An even number, divisible into two equal numbers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical arithmetic usage; the term contrasts with an odd number.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of cloth or silk brocade, including a cloth spread over a howdah.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun referring to the condition or institution of marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who marries often or has had many husbands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun for frequent remarriage.
